name: Upscale System LLC
description: CRM + lead-gen / done-for-you outbound growth partner for B2B companies — email, calling, and LinkedIn campaigns; pilot then scale. TrustMRR description mixes "CRM and Lead generation softwares" with outbound services. Founded Mar 2023, US. ~200 estimated users, 289 active subs.

mentions.evidence: ~$100,269 MRR, 289 active subscriptions, ~$84,224 L30, ~$768,741 all-time. Last sync Oct 3, 2026 ~06:04 Warsaw (04:04 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Package outbound (inbox + dialer + CRM) as a fixed-scope monthly product for one ICP (agencies, local services, SaaS). Services margin + software stickiness.

whyItPrints: Productized outbound + CRM seats. High MRR on a few hundred customers means real ACV. Selling "we book meetings" as recurring software/services hybrid — classic indie MSP-adjacent print.
whyThisMatters:
B2B companies hire Upscale to run outbound. The work is email, calls, and LinkedIn, and a booked meeting shows up in the CRM. Enrichment and follow-up sit in the same setup.

They open with a pilot: who to contact, which channel, what to say. Then they count replies, conversations, and real opportunities. If the pilot books meetings, they raise the volume. Notes get written back to the CRM, and quiet accounts can be tried again. If you only want the mailboxes, Warm Inboxes is the pre-warmed domains and inboxes behind the sending.

They say the volume is about a million emails a month, about 9,000 sending accounts, and more than 200 B2B companies. The customers they describe are SaaS firms, service businesses, agencies, and founders who still sell. The company is in Florida and started in March 2023.
